Two years ago, BLACKPINK's JISOO made her solo debut with the album ME, which gained worldwide recognition at the time!🌹🥀

The ME album featured two songs, FLOWER and ALL EYES ON ME. Among them, FLOWER had an official music video, while ALL EYES ON ME was released as an audio track only.🌷

FLOWER became one of the most trending songs globally at that time, garnering 44 MILLION views on YouTube within just 24 hours and surpassing 100 MILLION views in less than 8 days!🌸🏵️

The song gained immense popularity due to its poetic lyrics and JISOO’s unique vocals, with the central theme revolving around breaking free from a toxic relationship. Moreover, its hook step (🙌)  went massively viral!

At the same time, ALL EYES ON ME also received a great response, contributing to the success of the album.🔥

Today marks the 2nd anniversary of JISOO’s debut album ME!

Happy 2nd anniversary to ME, and thank you, JISOO, for blessing us with such a mesmerizing album. ❤️‍🩹 🪷🫶🏻🌷

author: @tulinyildirim1779
text:
JISOO on You in Radio part-2 

JISOO gives a sneak peek of her upcoming mini album AMORTAGE and Jisoo was asked if we can meet Rapper Jisoo in the new album 

She explains, “The word AMORTAGE is a combination of ‘Amor’ (love) and ‘Montage’ (film technique). The album has about four tracks, and when you listen to all of them, it feels like you’re hearing one love story.” 

The title track “earthquake” expresses the excitement and trembling feeling of falling in love for the first time, “It’s a song that captures that first moment of love, the excitement, the confusion… it’s like the world is shaking.” 

Jisoo also shares that the music video for earthquake was shot with a cinematic feel, “I wanted to make the AMORTAGE album feel like a movie, and the video is something really unique… I’m so excited to see the final result!” 

And for those wondering about challenges, Jisoo teases, “The song has rhythmic parts, and there’s a choreography that fits perfectly with it… wanna hear the challenge part?”

“You can’t meet rapper Jisoo. Rapper Jisoo doesn’t come easily.” When asked if we will one day see Rapper Jisoo if we wait,

 Jisoo replied, “Is there a need when our team has two amazing rappers?”

The release of "AMORTAGE" not only coincides with Valentine's Day, but is also accompanied by a special event. The pre-sale began this February 3 and has already generated great expectations globally.

Through her posts, Jisoo has shared interesting details about the album, this new musical work guarantees a perfect combination of fresh and experimental sounds.

"Amor Montage" combines two words:

1. Amor: This is a Latin-derived word, commonly used in Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian, meaning "love."

2. Montage: This is a French word meaning "assembly" or "editing," often used in the context of a collection or series of images, videos, or scenes arranged to tell a story or evoke emotions.

So, "Amor Montage" could refer to a "love montage," symbolizing a collection or sequence of moments, images, or scenes that are connected by the theme of love. It's often used in storytelling, films, or even to describe romantic highlights.

Blackpink's Jisoo has hinted at an exciting lineup of activities for 2025, tracking her move to a new agency. On December 25, KST, Jisoo's agency, Blissu, shared her Christmas photoshoot on her official social media account with the caption, "Happy Holidays, Blink."The agency expressed their gratitude, stating: “Thank you to everyone who supported Jisoo throughout 2024. We are working hard to prepare wonderful surprises for BLINKs, so please wait a little longer.” They added, “We hope you have a warm and joyful holiday with your loved ones, and may 2025 be a happy year with Jisoo. Thank you for your continued love and support. Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year.”Upcoming Projects
Jisoo has had a busy year focusing on acting, and her momentum is expected to continue into 2025.
• She will star in the Coupang Play series ‘Newtopia,’ set to air on February 7th.
• Jisoo has also been confirmed for the movie ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint,’ scheduled for release in 2025.
• Additionally, she is positively considering a role in the new drama ‘Monthly Boyfriend.’

𝗘𝗞: Please share some fun behind-the-scenes moments from Newtopia!
𝗝𝗜𝗦𝗢𝗢: Oh… there were so many! Newtopia involved a lot of special effects makeup for the genre, and people were so shocked that they thought we were actually injured. It almost led to someone reporting it!
𝗘𝗞: What would you do if you encountered a real zombie?
𝗝𝗜𝗦𝗢𝗢: Based on my experience filming this… definitely run away. I used to say, when asked, “What would you do if a horde of zombies came at you?” that I’d run straight toward them to be the first one bitten. I didn’t want to struggle and get bitten at the end, feeling tragic. I’d rather just get it over with quickly. But after filming, I realized… maybe it’s worth putting up a fight? I’d at least try to hold out a bit and survive at home.
𝗘𝗞: Time to promote Newtopia!
𝗝𝗜𝗦𝗢𝗢: Newtopia is a zombie apocalypse genre project I had the chance to work on. Filming it was so much fun, and I think viewers will find it refreshing as well. It’s a work with endless potential. Please look forward to it!
